notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Last week was published an [url=https://lopespm.github.io/libraries/games/2018/12/27/camera-multi-target.html]open source Unity library[/url] that was developed for, and used by Survival Ball. This library dynamically keeps multiple objects inside a camera view, meaning that much of the game's camera work is handled by this single library.

While writing the blog post this library, some performance improvements were made apparent when going over the math used by the camera calculations. These improvements were included in the library, and are now also integrated into the game code, which results into a more performant game.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Linux Wine Compatibility
notes.content:
Following an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/918690/discussions/0/3104564981110411713/]issue[/url] raised by [i]Peanut Butler[/i], this update ships a fix which improves compatibility when running via Wine/[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/221410/announcements/detail/1696055855739350561]Proton[/url] for Linux.

Compatibility has been confirmed on Ubuntu 18.04.1 LTS, using Steam's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/221410/announcements/detail/1696055855739350561]Proton 3.16-4 Beta[/url] (which uses Wine) to run the Windows version of Survival Ball on this Linux distro.

notes.title: Indie X. It was awesome.
notes.content:
Indie X @ Lisboa Games Week 2018 was awesome, huge word of thanks to the organizers! A custom build was made specially for this event, which featured a more arcade experience by having local leaderbords and access to all of the game levels. In the below video, you can see some of the major features of special build for this event:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m6X0yNZu-PI

Notice as well the added controls help UI when the game is paused. Purpose being to show the controls for players who may not have passed by the tutorial. Do you think this would be a nice add to the published Steam version?


After 4 showcase days at Lisboa Games Week, these are the highscores for all the game levels 🏆:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sq_ysEqgPsU

Off course, no showcase could be complete without the fine gamers who came to play and comment the game. Here are some pictures and videos of the gamers who played Survival Ball at Lisboa Games Week: https://twitter.com/survivalball/status/1064556805630697477

notes.title: Beta Update 0.1.3 - Widescreen Aspect Ratios
notes.content:
This update is mostly focused on improving the support for various wide screen aspect ratios:
[list]
    [*]Layout adjustments in order for the game to correctly present wide screen aspect ratios other than 16:9
    [*]Restrict the possible video aspect ratios to wide screen only, since the game's visual balance is better suited for those.
    [*]Fixed ghost transition which happened when a game was deleted and a new game was made in its place, without game restart. 
[/list] 

Apart from this, the MacOS version is currently being prepared and tested, so it should not take long for it to be available as well!

notes.title: Welcome to the Closed Beta
notes.content:
Greetings!

Before its public release, Survival Ball is ongoing a closed beta to work out any kinks that might have went unnoticed and gather more feedback from what works, what doesn't, what is good the way it is and what could be improved.

If you want to join this stage and share your voice, please make your request via: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1cm0Ru6Cf5UxaWWWmvIKjhI01CaCA1udYz5lypGUCj5A
